synopsis: Chapter 12 cites EUR-Lex regulation text and the European Commission’s announcement for the Digital Omnibus adoption date of 8 July 2026 and entry-into-force date of 27 July 2026 [f10311, f10312]. It reports application dates of 2 December 2027 and 2 August 2028 from those same sources, without specifying which provisions apply on each date [f10313]. In contrast, Chapter 9 relies on August 2026 Eurogip commentary, not verified on EUR-Lex, for the possibility that harmonised AI Act standards may confer a presumption of conformity under the Machinery Regulation until machinery-specific AI delegated acts expected by 2 August 2028 [f7431]. The corpus therefore distinguishes reported legal milestones from an unverified interpretation that should remain qualified in planning [f10311, f10312, f10313, f7431].

relations.note: Entry into force follows adoption in the reported Digital Omnibus timeline.
Reported application dates follow entry into force.
